title: ppg-pda-analysis: pulse decomposition analysis of the photoplethysmogram and its validity as a vascular index
description:
Analysis code and frozen pre-registrations for a research programme testing whether indices derived from pulse decomposition analysis (PDA) of the photoplethysmogram carry vascular information, and whether they can correct pulse-wave-transit-time-based cardiac output estimation (esCCO).

Contains the frozen two-component skewed-Gaussian decomposition, the derived indices (ΔT, RI, SI), the fiducial-point and early-amplitude-ratio comparators, the VitalDB and Pulse Wave Database analysis scripts, and the statistical analysis plans as frozen before the confirmatory analyses. The scripts that carry the confirmatory and exploratory analyses (23 of 37) run a synthetic-data verification suite offline under --selftest; the data-acquisition, figure and table scripts operate on downloaded or already-extracted data. The measurement pipeline is verified separately against ground truth in analysis/tests/.

No patient data are included. The analyses run against the public VitalDB and Pulse Wave Database.
